Maria brings over 16 years of experience in the customer support industry, with a strong background in technical support and customer service for U.S.-based clients. Throughout her career, she has held various leadership and operational roles, including Quality Assurance, Operations, Training & Development, and Performance Development Coaching. Although relatively new to the insurance sector, Maria has transitioned seamlessly, leveraging her expertise in accuracy, communication, and client-focused service. Her technical foundation and coaching mindset enable her to navigate complex policies while ensuring clients feel supported and understood.

A dedicated working mother of three, Maria balances her professional career with family life on the beautiful island of Camiguin in the Philippines, once featured in The New York Times. Outside of work, she enjoys exploring the island’s natural beauty with her family and believes that true work-life balance is not just a goal, but a way of life.
